newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 18.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's Daily Variety:
* Miramax's "Cop Land" finished first for the weekend with an estimated $12.8 million.
* UPN is expected this week to name Disney TV veteran Dean Valentine as the successor to its departing president and CEO, Lucie Salhany.

* United Artists Theatre Group is expected to announce as early as today that it is reviewing its "strategic alternatives," including whether to do a public stock offering or possibly offer itself for sale.
* Atom Egoyan, the acclaimed Canuck director, has signed a deal with Mel Gibson and Bruce Davey's Icon Prods. to direct "Felicia's Journey," based on the novel by William Trevor.

* New Line Cinema is sealing a deal with special effects creator Rob Bottin to direct the battle between Freddy Krueger, of the "Nightmare on Elm Street" films, and Jason Voorhees, of the "Friday the 13th" series.
* Alex Linz is set to topline the eccentric comedy "Bruno" under Shirley Maclaine's direction for producer David Kirkpatrick.
